GUI_PLUGIN_FORBIDDEN: Native GUI access is not allowed for this window or runtime
GUI_PLUGIN_UNTRUSTED_SOURCE: Native GUI plugins must come from the local managed OpenCode service
GUI_PLUGIN_DOCUMENT_RESTRICTED: This document runs window-only plugins; reload before using native capabilities
GUI_PLUGIN_UNAVAILABLE: The native GUI plugin or IPC provider is unavailable
GUI_PLUGIN_LEASE_EXPIRED: The native GUI authorization has expired
GUI_PLUGIN_REVISION_MISMATCH: The GUI plugin revision changed; refresh plugins
GUI_PLUGIN_INVALID_INPUT: The GUI IPC input does not match its schema
GUI_PLUGIN_INVALID_OUTPUT: The GUI IPC output does not match its schema
GUI_PLUGIN_ABORTED: The GUI IPC operation was aborted
GUI_PLUGIN_UNSUPPORTED: This GUI capability is not supported by the current runtime
GUI_PLUGIN_FAILED: The native GUI plugin operation failed
